release_notes: Keeps OTA rollback armed until the updated Qt/QML shell has loaded, required bridges are ready and the application crosses a deliberate event-loop health boundary.
Prevents a premature/stale validated marker from committing an updated application that has already exited with an error.
Consolidates shell modal pages onto the shared QML modal authority and restores consistent Escape, background blocking, positioning and motion behavior.
Restores one shared keyboard-focus authority for the sidebar toggle, composite date field, filled buttons and History row selection.
Makes Proforma/Tax Invoice item-entry fields responsive at the supported minimum window width instead of forcing an over-wide single row.
Gives update preparation/helper-launch failures an explicit error state so the shared updater status light reports failure rather than update-available amber.
Validates every OTA HTTP redirect against a narrow HTTPS host/path policy instead of trusting only the initial URL.
Rejects fractional, Boolean and non-canonical schema metadata in the narrowly scoped legacy transaction compatibility bridge.
Improves shared text/focus contrast and centralizes remaining system-level typography and motion timings.
Uses the shared table/modal surface treatment for the Settings personal-dictionary UI instead of local square/radius overrides.
Holds verified Windows helper/installer files against write/delete replacement across the final integrity check and immediate process launch.
Source release metadata now generates these v1.2.1 notes directly; no post-generation release-note overlay is required.
Keeps History/Settings/Diagnostics modal pages fully blocking while showing a shared Sapphire warning when the user clicks outside and must close the current window first.
Fixes History -> Open transitions so Quotation, Proforma and Tax Invoice records open without leaving an empty modal overlay over the editor.
Simplifies shared button focus to one complete rounded outline and preserves the Writing Suggestions popup's rounded lower corners.
Adds a shared Sapphire "Save & Close" application-exit confirmation for user-initiated window close/Alt+F4 while verified updater/restart shutdowns remain non-interactive.
Keeps the native file picker but moves existing-file overwrite confirmation into the shared QML/Sapphire prompt system for consistent export UI.
Stabilizes Dashboard card footers and the expanded navigation rail during ordinary window resizing so persistent controls no longer drift with responsive content.
Uses keyboard-visible focus rather than raw pointer focus for shared buttons, preventing the hamburger and Close buttons from remaining Sapphire-highlighted after a mouse click.

Uses one shared coordinate-aware blocking input guard for History/Settings/Diagnostics so blocked app-navigation attempts reliably produce the Sapphire close-current-window warning without intercepting controls inside the modal.

Uses a passive PointHandler on the window overlay (not inside Overlay.modal) to retain press coordinates before modal routing discards the underlying action, then routes only real navigation-target hits through the shared Sapphire notice authority.
Renders keyboard focus as a separate perimeter halo instead of changing the rounded button body border width, eliminating the residual Close-button corner fragment at Windows display scaling.

Routes blocked History/Settings/Diagnostics interaction through the same non-modal Sapphire notice used by editor navigation guards, removing the stacked-modal deadlock and keeping Close/Alt+F4 available.

Narrows the shell-modal warning to actual blocked navigation destinations: clicks inside History/Settings/Diagnostics (including Revision and Close), blank dimmed workspace clicks and the hamburger no longer produce a false close-current-window notice.

Removes the obsolete string-only blockedInteractionText assignment from the nested Revision History popup after the shared modal API moved to coordinate-aware shell reporting, restoring real Qt/QML loader compatibility for the corrected interaction path.

Moves the coordinate-aware modal pointer observer onto a dedicated transparent high-z glass pane so Windows modal routing cannot consume blocked navigation presses before the passive PointHandler sees them; internal popup clicks remain geometry-filtered and silent.

Replaces the unsuccessful global glass-pane observer with a sidebar-only modal navigation interception layer: while History/Settings/Diagnostics is open, only the visible navigation rail is intercepted above the modal scrim, mapped back to the existing named navigation targets, and routed through the same non-modal Sapphire warning; the modal workspace and all controls inside it are never covered.

Replaces the unsuccessful true-Qt-modal interception experiments with an application-controlled modal surface: History/Settings/Diagnostics remain centered, dim and block the workspace, but the shell popup is modeless at the Qt input-routing layer so normal sidebar commands reach the shared navigation guard and can reliably show the close-current-window warning; internal popup controls remain isolated from that navigation path.
Product version: 1.2.1
Database schema: 10 (unchanged)
Local AppData path: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Quotation Manager (unchanged)
Installer AppId/install location: unchanged
v1.2.0 is the mandatory direct rollback installer for the v1.2.0 -> v1.2.1 OTA upgrade.
